LanguageData.APM.FrostivusFoodPreservation.ManualUnlo: Choose a cell where Frostivus should unload all preserved food. Manually unloaded food will be forbidden.
LanguageData.APM.FrostivusFoodPreservation.CommandUna: Frostivus cannot take preservation orders right now.
LanguageData.APM.FrostivusFoodPreservation.ReleaseDev: Choose a cell where Frostivus should release swallowed pawns or corpses.
No swallowed pawn or corpse carried.
LanguageData.APM.FrostivusFoodPreservation.CryptoSwal: Frostivus can only swallow a spawned humanlike pawn or corpse on its map.
Frostivus can swallow any humanlike corpse or downed pawn, but only living colonists, prisoners, or slaves.
